September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30), all shifts. Window coverage: complete.
Contribution margin not set: without an owner margin no lost contribution is priced, so the dollars are paper and machine time.
The ownership lens: the total cost of the waste recorded, side trim first, then the rest by dollars.

The rest are the dry-end waste, shear, the changeover rejects, the cutoff-knife and stacker waste boards, planning / admin (not production waste) and the unexplained remainder (the scale reading less the recorded waste).
Each line of the waste breakdown is priced once, so the total is the waste breakdown's.
The dry-end waste is the tag scrap: bond, warp, misalignment, moisture and other, one subtotal with each kind beneath it.
Per year at the post's volumes.
